title: VT350 · Left head on the
foot: Real Blender Cycles renders (render.py, the render colour map, AgX Punchy, −1.4 EV), one every 10° round the toolhead at three heights. Drag sideways to turn it, up or down to change the height; arrow keys work too. Only these angles exist: for any angle, use the live 3D viewer (vt350#220).
